results.success_criteria: If the gradient-boosted model achieves lower MAE, RMSE, and higher R² scores compared to the degree-day model, the hypothesis is supported. If the degree-day model performs equally well or better, the hypothesis is refuted.
results.notes: XGBoost model achieved better performance than the degree-day model on at least 2 out of 3 metrics (MAE, RMSE, R²). The hypothesis is supported.
